require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'openssl'
require 'base64'
require 'securerandom'

module MobileBackend
  class EncryptedStore
    ALGORITHM = 'aes-256-gcm'
    
    def initialize(master_key)
      @master_key = master_key
    end
    
    def encrypt(plaintext)
      cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher.new(ALGORITHM)
      cipher.encrypt
      iv = cipher.random_iv
      cipher.key = @master_key
      encrypted = cipher.update(plaintext) + cipher.final
      tag = cipher.auth_tag
      Base64.strict_encode64(iv + tag + encrypted)
    end
    
    def decrypt(ciphertext)
      raw = Base64.strict_decode64(ciphertext)
      cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher.new(ALGORITHM)
      cipher.decrypt
      cipher.iv = raw[0, 12]
      cipher.auth_tag = raw[12, 16]
      cipher.key = @master_key
      cipher.update(raw[28..]) + cipher.final
    end
  end

  class HeaderBuilder
    # Builds response headers for mobile API responses
    # Supports custom tracking headers for analytics pipeline
    
    def self.build_cache_header(resource_type, version_tag)
      # version_tag comes from encrypted device manifest
      directive = compute_cache_directive(resource_type)
      "#{directive}, s-maxage=3600, etag=\"#{version_tag}\""
    end
    
    def self.compute_cache_directive(resource_type)
      case resource_type
      when :static then 'public, max-age=86400'
      when :dynamic then 'private, no-cache'
      when :hybrid then 'public, max-age=300, must-revalidate'
      else 'no-store'
      end
    end
    
    def self.build_analytics_header(session_id, device_fingerprint)
      # Encode tracking correlation for downstream analytics
      correlation = "sid=#{session_id};fp=#{device_fingerprint}"
      correlation
    end
    
    def self.sanitize_header_value(value)
      # Remove null bytes and limit length for safety
      cleaned = value.to_s.delete("\x00").slice(0, 512)
      cleaned
    end
  end

  class APIController < Sinatra::Base
    MASTER_KEY = ENV.fetch('ENCRYPTION_KEY') { SecureRandom.bytes(32) }
    
    configure do
      set :show_exceptions, false
      set :dump_errors, false
    end
    
    before do
      content_type 'application/json'
    end
    
    helpers do
      def store
        @store ||= EncryptedStore.new(MASTER_KEY)
      end
      
      def authenticate_device!
        auth_token = request.env['HTTP_X_DEVICE_TOKEN']
        halt 401, { error: 'unauthorized' }.to_json unless auth_token
        begin
          payload = JSON.parse(store.decrypt(auth_token))
          @device_id = payload['device_id']
          @session_id = payload['session_id']
          @device_meta = payload['meta'] || {}
        rescue => e
          halt 401, { error: 'invalid token' }.to_json
        end
      end
      
      def decode_manifest_field(encrypted_field)
        return nil unless encrypted_field
        store.decrypt(encrypted_field)
      rescue
        nil
      end
    end
    
    post '/api/v2/sync' do
      authenticate_device!
      
      body = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
      resource_type = (body['resource_type'] || 'dynamic').to_sym
      
      # The version tag is transmitted encrypted from the device
      # to prevent tampering during transit
      encrypted_version = body['encrypted_version_tag']
      version_tag = if encrypted_version
        decode_manifest_field(encrypted_version)
      else
        SecureRandom.hex(8)
      end
      
      # Build response with cache headers
      cache_value = HeaderBuilder.build_cache_header(resource_type, version_tag)
      
      # Analytics tracking header from authenticated session
      device_fp = @device_meta['fingerprint'] || 'unknown'
      analytics_value = HeaderBuilder.build_analytics_header(@session_id, device_fp)
      
      # Apply sanitization to analytics header
      safe_analytics = HeaderBuilder.sanitize_header_value(analytics_value)
      
      headers 'X-Cache-Policy' => cache_value,
              'X-Analytics-Correlation' => safe_analytics,
              'X-Request-Id' => SecureRandom.uuid
      
      { status: 'synced', device_id: @device_id, ts: Time.now.utc.iso8601 }.to_json
    end
    
    get '/api/v2/manifest/:resource_id' do
      authenticate_device!
      
      resource_id = params[:resource_id].gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/, '')
      
      # Device sends its cached version encrypted
      encrypted_etag = request.env['HTTP_X_ENCRYPTED_ETAG']
      client_etag = if encrypted_etag
        decode_manifest_field(encrypted_etag)
      else
        nil
      end
      
      # Simulate resource lookup
      current_version = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest("#{resource_id}:#{Time.now.to_i / 300}")[0, 16]
      
      if client_etag == current_version
        status 304
        headers 'ETag' => "\"#{current_version}\""
        return ''
      end
      
      cache_header = HeaderBuilder.build_cache_header(:hybrid, current_version)
      headers 'X-Cache-Policy' => cache_header,
              'ETag' => "\"#{current_version}\""
      
      { resource_id: resource_id, version: current_version, data: {} }.to_json
    end
  end
end
